messages:
nina_sales: URGENT: Acme POC demo hitting intermittent 5xxs during a staged ramp. Client on call, they're asking about SLAs and whether this is an inherent platform limit. Can we triage?

omar_se: Which route/model and sample request ids? Load profile?

nina_sales: Route `acme-enterprise-poc`, model `redwood-serve-xl`. Ramp 10 -> 110 RPS over ~2m. Seen ids: aid-55, aid-56, aid-57.

rachel_support: Edge logs: 
```
[2026-05-21T11:03:12Z] request_id=aid-55 upstream_error: attach_timeout
[2026-05-21T11:03:14Z] request_id=aid-56 response=503 reason="burstpool_full"
[2026-05-21T11:03:38Z] request_id=aid-57 upstream_error: autoscaler_err: insufficient_region_capacity
```

dave_oncall: Autoscaler attempted scale-up at 11:03:13. Cloud API returned capacity error for non-preemptible pool; attach retries exhausted, fallback to shared-burstpool triggered. Burstpool reached queue depth and began returning 503s.

omar_se: Short-term options: 1) throttle client to soft_limit 45 RPS, 2) enable fallback model `redwood-serve-xl-quant` and set `max_concurrency=1`, 3) flip `elastic_burst=true` to allow short temporary burst headroom. Medium-term: allocate a dedicated instance for the POC.

nina_sales: Acme wants minimal quality impact on the demo. Any ETA for dedicated capacity?

dave_oncall: We can provision a dedicated-small in-region, ETA ~2-4h if procurement approves expedited allocation; otherwise 24-72h. I've opened ticket CH-10012 (owner: @omar_se).

rachel_support: I can run a quick route patch: set `soft_limit_rps=45`, `fallback_model=redwood-serve-xl-quant`, `max_concurrency=1`. Would reduce errors but degrade some outputs. Also bundle logs for Acme and propose a one-time credit for POC.

infra-bot: Applying patch to route `acme-enterprise-poc`: {soft_limit_rps=45, fallback_model=redwood-serve-xl-quant, max_concurrency=1, elastic_burst=true} (patch id: patch-8441).

infra-bot: Patch applied. Observed 503 -> 200 ratio drop: error_rate ~20% -> ~3% over 40s. Some requests served by quant fallback.

omar_se: I'll own CH-10012 and push for expedited dedicated node. Also prepping a short note on cost uplift: dedicated-small ~+28% for the POC week, or we can offer a targeted credit to cover immediate instability.

nina_sales: I'll offer (1) immediate mitigation + log bundle, (2) one-time credit for demo, (3) proposed dedicated-small with SLA for next phase. Also asking Acme if Private deployment is required to eliminate shared burstpool concerns.

dave_oncall: Private (VPC + dedicated infra) is available but multi-week. If they require isolation for compliance, we'll start the intake. For now dedicated-small should address capacity.

rachel_support: Logged credit and uploaded log bundle to the Deal record. Also noted mitigation steps and owners.

nina_sales: Recap owners: mitigation & logs (rachel_support), capacity ticket CH-10012 (omar_se), compliance/audit thread (dave_oncall), sales credit + proposal (nina_sales).

omar_se: If any new 5xxs appear after the patch, paste request IDs here and I'll escalate immediate attach retries and force failover to reserved pool.

nina_sales: Thanks team. Joining the demo to walk through the backup plan. Will update when Acme confirms next steps. :thumbsup:
